name: Coding Components PAO System
description: 100 Logic Components and 100 Visual Elements indexed by PAO system (00-99)

logicComponents.description: 100 Logic Components - the invisible mechanisms that process data and manage state

visualElements.description: 100 Visual Elements - the visible parts of the interface users interact with

paoMapping.description: Each PAO index (00-99) maps to one Logic Component AND one Visual Element
paoMapping.format: Index NN: Logic Component #NN + Visual Element #NN
paoMapping.example: Index 00: Global State Manager + Text Input
